title: Pan De Yucca
hookLine: Global-inspired pan de yucca with 9 measured ingredients — zero sign-up, instant Cook Mode.

steps.title: Prep & Mix: Pan De Yucca
steps.instructionTemplate: Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Grease and flour a 12 x 8' pyrex (you can use a smaller pyrex if you prefer the bread to be thicker). Incorporate {m53537_1}, {m53537_2}, {m53537_3}, and {m53537_4} smoothly until evenly distributed.
steps.creatorSecret: Prep and measure raw yucca first—mise en place makes this dessert twice as fast.

steps.title: Build Flavor: Pan De Yucca
steps.instructionTemplate: Peel and shred the yucca and set aside. In a medium bowl, combine flour, baking powder and salt and set aside. In a large bowl cream the butter with the sugar. Beat in the eggs, one at a time, then stir in the vanilla. Incorporate {m53537_5}, {m53537_6}, {m53537_7}, {m53537_8}, and {m53537_9} smoothly until evenly distributed.

steps.title: Shape & Layer: Pan De Yucca
steps.instructionTemplate: Add half of the dry ingredients and mix well, add cream cheese, mix well and, add the other half of the dry ingredients and mix well. With a wooden spoon incorporate the shredded yucca, until well incorporated.

steps.title: Bake / Chill: Pan De Yucca
steps.instructionTemplate: Pour or spoon batter into the prepared pan and cook for 45 to 55 min. Let Pan De Yucca cool for 10–15 minutes so the crumb sets cleanly before slicing into 4 portions, then garnish and serve.
steps.criticalTip: Let set for 5–10 minutes before slicing or plating so the textures hold crisp and photogenic!
steps.creatorSecret: Measure aromatics and syrups before heating so timing stays crisp and your glaze hits glossy perfection.

ugcQuotes.quote: Followed the scaled metric steps—came out flawless in 45 mins!
